summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Structured Obligations Corporation as registrant for the Select Notes Trust LT 2004-1, an asset-backed security trust. The filing reports a regular interest distribution to certificate holders on July 1, 2026, with an interest receipt of $100,500.00. It includes standard disclaimers that neither the registrant nor the trustee participated in preparing or verifying issuer reports. There is no corporate event, transaction, or special situation disclosed; it is merely an ordinary periodic reporting obligation under Section 8.01 for a trust distribution.
